name: replay-net
goal: Play again: host + 3 real clients play a whole game, stay 6 s on the ending screen, the host ends it ('Terminer la partie' → every process back to the main menu), then hosts a second game in the SAME processes; the clients join again and the second game plays to its end. Whatever survives a game (statics, singletons, cached sessions, subscriptions) must not break the second one: no error, no desync, same winners everywhere at the second ending.
